Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Answered 6 identification prompts; 4 were unaided correct.
Described standing as up-down, sleeping as horizontal, and slanting as tilted.
Explained that a tilted line can remain straight if it does not bend.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Om practised naming standing, sleeping and slanting lines using visual descriptions such as up-down, horizontal, and tilted. They also explained that a tilted line can still be straight when it does not bend. Asha recorded no misconception, though the teach-back was not yet passed. At home, ask Om to find and name one example of each line type in everyday objects or drawings.
